newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Productions cuts exercise price.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Productions cuts exercise price.

text.p: Hollywood Productions Inc said Wednesday it decreased the exercise price of its warrants to $3.00 from $6.50 on June 23.
Company officials were not available to eleborate.
Hollywood's warrants traded at 7/8 Wednesday afternoon, down 1/16. The company's stock hit an intra-day annual low of 1-3/16 and was trading at 1-3/16, down 1/16.

Hollywood also said it expects its swim wear division's 1997 sales to increase to about $5.1 million, a 6.3 increase over 1996. The division reported $4.8 million in sales for the year ended December 31 1996, a statement said.
